question: Which figure is different from the others?

why: In figures 1 to 4 the middle bar is white on top and black at the bottom. In figure 5 it is the other way round: black on top, white at the bottom. The side triangles change in every figure, so they do not decide it.
trick: Compare one part at a time; the part that stays the same in all but one figure gives the answer.
